card.statement:
We consider the algebra $\mathscr{B}(\mathcal{O}(\mathcal{X}))$ as the mirror to the equivariant quantum cohomology algebra $H^{*}_{T^{!}}(X^{!};\Lambda^{\prime})$ ; the isomorphism is induced by passing to $\hbar=0$ in the isomorphism $M_{eq,reg}\cong M^{!}_{Kah,reg}$ . Note that both left multiplication by images of $\Lambda$ and the quantum Steenrod operations $\Sigma_{x}^{T^{!}}$ define an algebra action. In particular, the quantum multiplication in quantum cohomology is mirror to ordinary multiplication.
∎

3.2.2. Lonergan’s construction of Frobenius splitting for Coulomb branches

There is a general construction of the Frobenius-constant quantization of Coulomb branches for a gauge theory $(G,V)$ due to Lonergan, cf. [Lon21]. We briefly sketch this construction, as (i) we later use the description to compute the Frobenius splitting for hypertoric varieties, and (ii) we would like to highlight the similarity of this construction and the construction of quantum Steenrod operations. For a complete description, the reader is referred to the original paper [Lon21].

The starting point is to consider the following generalization of the affine Grassmannian. Let $X$ be a curve, $S^{\prime}\subseteq S$ a finite set and a subset. Denote by $\Delta_{S}(x)$ the union of formal disc neighborhoods of $x_{s}\in X$ for all $s\in S$ . Denote by $\Delta_{S}^{S^{\prime}}(x)$ the complement of the graphs of $\{x_{s}\}_{s\in S^{\prime}}$ in $\Delta_{S}(x)$ , i.e. introducing punctures at points indexed by $s\in S^{\prime}$ .

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
